answer: Unlike the fable of instant trust, reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so influence requires sustained honest service. In the EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned sybil identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted links cannot create trusted mass without credible peers, while temporal decay erodes collusive gains. Neither an ember of activity nor an onyx cluster can meet consensus thresholds by appearing alone.
